name: lol-vod-review
description: Auto-record League of Legends games and rank the moments worth reviewing.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/schema -w packages/core && npm run dev -w apps/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build -w packages/schema -w packages/core && cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/recorder/Cargo.toml && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
